scope: Research/code completeness and local restricted-corpus review preparation

existing_application_code.scope: Application helpers, tests, scripts and preview source; not captured upstream code or original Git history.

research_expansion.additional_inventory: Four authored checkpoint freeze/test/verifier scripts were found outside the research tools directories; duplicate verifier copies may be consolidated only with explicit mapping.

local_review_tool.unit_fixture_limit: Positive unit fixtures isolate repository-location detection to keep fixtures under tests; actual repository refusal is tested separately and real preparation used a new non-repository local output.

remaining_release_blockers: Mechanical redaction may retain confidential meaning, unidentified names or encoded secrets.
Opaque attachments have not undergone content review or scrubbing.
No affirmative source/data-owner release decision for the exact scrubbed corpus/destination was obtained.
Private original histories, raw transcripts, archives and captured third-party source are not included in the safe publication.

captured_upstream_repository.scope: Previously retained upstream reference snapshot, not project-authored application or research-tool code.
captured_upstream_repository.inspection_limit: Counts came from the actual git_type inventory field; an initial projection used absent type fields and was corrected before recording these counts.

full_integration.environment: PYTHONPATH explicitly set to ignored research_tools/.validation-deps
full_integration.skip_reason: Existing actual synthetic symlink-creation cases lack Windows privilege; no elevation or workaround.
full_integration.research_dependencies: Declared packages restored only after missing-parser errors, into an ignored owned directory; no vendor code is included in publication.

false_positive_review.disposition: Explicitly synthetic ExampleProject/example-org service-alias URLs used by passive classifier tests; no actual private endpoint or network operation. Exact fixture-only matches were reviewed, not globally ignored.
